description:
Wildberries / Ozon product card: title, price (RUB), rating, reviews, stock. Live product data for a Wildberries (wildberries.ru, wb.ru) or Ozon (ozon.ru) product URL: title, current price in RUB (original_amount = list price before discount when known), rating, reviews_count and availability. Cached 10 min per product. If the marketplace blocks or fails, returns 502 upstream_unavailable and the payment is NOT settled. Can take up to ~40s when the live page has to be rendered.

GET /product/info — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

url.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)
